notes: compensation grades the board's terms for a low-speed current reading and specifies the dynamic two-zero tracker as the current zero's method, graded against the stage 1 captures, the stage 2 bemf-coast datasets of mg90-c (capture-1, capture-2, low-1, low-meter-3) and mg90-b (capture-1), and mg90-c's trough-4, the recording with the trough sample in every row. awake_step_*: the open bridge 1-20 ms after each coast cut over the cycle's torque-off baseline mean, per rail, mg90-c, the bounds one standard error over the coasts; awake_step_mg90b_counts the same on mg90-b. asleep_zero_counts: the baseline mean per rail. step_shape: the fits of the step against the coast's rail per spin. motor_trough: trough-4's trough sample under the holds, settled rows over the trough baseline, against the same chain's late coast (10 ms past the cut to the end) in its own column (same_column) and in the crest column (crest_column), the bounds one standard error; its duty step, slopes, time and speed terms, and the coast levels reproduced. frame_offset: the trough sample over the crest sample at rest and with the bridge open awake. switching_share: the motor's trough, the dropout rows and the dummy's trough over the open bridge. tracker_replay: the tick-exact port through each of the five datasets' timelines with the motor's measured trough level synthesized at feeding widths, the error against the dataset's own per-rail open bridge; warm = the first chain left out; the variants feed the dummy's level (d), the dropout level (e), the open bridge (b) and a 1 s brake. gate_candidates: per feeding gate, the zero error the widest admitted hold feeds and the real-feed replay's scores. real_feed_replay: the port through trough-4 on its own trough samples per gate, the error against the chain's own late coast; steady = the two rail-step chains out as well. convergence: the exact port under continuous dithered feed. methods_pooled: on the modeled replay, A the tracker, B0 the tracker + slope x (rail - rail at the last feed), B with a rail EWMA, C the asleep zero + mg90-c capture-1's three-rail table by the live rail, Cline the same with the line; warm, the last 200 ms. recommended_form: the tracker alone with the 30 % gate and its constants, its residual stated. comparison: the table and the rail term, the bounds they set, not deliverables. board_terms: each term in rev/s at low speed through mg90-c's own R and Ke. motor_constants: mg90-c's from its own stall pass and coasts, mg90-b's from its stage 2 results.

tracker_replay.synthetic_trough: the motor's measured trough over the open bridge, same column, per rail

30pct.unmeasured: no 30 % rung at 5 and 7.4 V; nothing between 40 and 60 % but at 3.7 V

40pct.unmeasured: no 30 % rung at 5 and 7.4 V; nothing between 40 and 60 % but at 3.7 V

60pct.unmeasured: no 30 % rung at 5 and 7.4 V; nothing between 40 and 60 % but at 3.7 V

real_feed_replay.truth: the chain's own late coast, crest column, 10 ms past the cut to the end
real_feed_replay.feed: every streamed row's trough sample; the brake, the rests and the pre-drive coast synthesized as in the modeled replay

recommended_form.form: the dynamic two-zero tracker alone: an EWMA per zero of the trough shunt sample, the asleep zero fed with the driver disabled, the awake zero fed by coasts and brakes after the settle and by slow-decay drives at 30 % duty and under; a stale zero follows the other; both seeded from the install's rest; the reading is the crest sample less the awake zero
recommended_form.why: the zero is a property of the board that moves with the rail and the temperature; the tracker reads it on the board in service where the reading it serves is taken, at no cost at identification; a per-rail table would need the zero read at three rails, three supplies on every bench

table_three_rail.form: the asleep zero + a per-board table of the awake step at three rails, linear between, by the live rail; no awake tracking
table_three_rail.table_source: mg90-c capture-1, the open bridge 1-20 ms after the coast cut, per rail
table_three_rail.status: the bound a static method reaches on this board and the grading truth's own reproducibility; not a deliverable, identification cannot ask a user for three supplies

rail_ewma_term.form: the tracker + the line's slope x (the live rail - a rail EWMA fed on the awake-fed ticks)
rail_ewma_term.status: the one refinement that needs no identification step; it carries the line's wrong shape, +/- 0.5 counts per rail; not recommended
